reviews.comment: Taught for another professor last minute, so he used other professors material. Fair, but tough grader. Wants you to learn, not just pass course. Take advantage of his office hours, well worth your time and effort. He will "guide" you during office hours on exactly what he is looking for.  You will be a better student after taking his course.

He is a tough grader but in this finance class, there were not many assignments, mainly 2 group projects, one individual project, and no exams! He grades tough on punctuation however the assignments arent very difficult pretty straight forward and he allows you to turn in early to get feedback. He also gives extra credit for THIS class.

This course was only 1 hour of credit. With the amount of work that he allotted, it should have counted for 4 hours. His lectures could put me to sleep. He doesn't seem like he cares about his students at all. He grades unnecessarily hard. My writing skills are proficient and he says otherwise. For reference, I got an A in SPMT 265.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader
